2609.30186.title: Jev-Mobile: Jev as an Executor for Mobile GUI Agents
2609.30186.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for autonomous mobile GUI agents, but most existing systems rely on the VLM for both planning and action grounding at nearly every interaction step, leading to substantial latency and model-serving cost. We introduce Jev-Mobile, which shifts this paradigm to low-frequency VLM planning and high-frequency lightweight execution: the VLM specifies local goals, the accessibility tree defines a structured executable action space, and Jev, a fast typed decision model, repeatedly selects actions within this space. This design allows multiple GUI actions to be executed under a single VLM decision, reducing expensive VLM inference while preserving adaptive interaction. On the full AndroidWorld task suite, Jev-Mobile achieves 79% task success, compared with 78% for SeeAct-V and 84% for a Step-wise VLM baseline. Among successful trajectories, it reduces mean end-to-end execution time by 32.7% and mean model API cost by 73.4% relative to Step-wise VLM. These results show that decoupling high-level VLM reasoning from low-level action execution can substantially improve mobile GUI agent efficiency while maintaining competitive task performance.
2609.30186.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型（VLMs）已成為自主移動 GUI 代理的常見基礎，但大多數現有系統在幾乎每個互動步驟中都依賴 VLM 進行規劃和行動基礎，導致顯著的延遲和模型服務成本。我們介紹了 Jev-Mobile，這一設計將這一範式轉變為低頻 VLM 規劃和高頻輕量執行：VLM 指定局部目標，無障礙樹定義結構化的可執行動作空間，而 Jev，這個快速類型的決策模型，則在這個空間內反覆選擇行動。這一設計允許在單一 VLM 決策下執行多個 GUI 行動，減少了昂貴的 VLM 推理，同時保留了自適應互動。在完整的 AndroidWorld 任務套件中，Jev-Mobile 實現了 79% 的任務成功率，而 SeeAct-V 為 78%，逐步 VLM 基準則為 84%。在成功的軌跡中，相對於逐步 VLM，它將平均端到端執行時間減少了 32.7%，平均模型 API 成本減少了 73.4%。這些結果表明，將高層次的 VLM 推理與低層次的行動執行解耦可以顯著提高移動 GUI 代理的效率，同時保持競爭性的任務表現。
